destination.title: Supersymmetric scalar potentials, vacuum stability and cosmology
destination.question: How do supersymmetric model ingredients control scalar potentials, vacuum energy, stability, inflation and supersymmetry breaking?
destination.summary: The original numerical co-membership is useful for exploration, provided vacuum energy is distinguished from Euclidean action and global supersymmetry from supergravity. No-scale constructions, higher-derivative mechanisms, flux models, inflationary stabilization and hidden-sector phenomenology remain distinct routes within the broad family.

systems: N=1 chiral supergravity models and effective theories
Four-dimensional effective models derived from five-dimensional gauged supergravity
Global Wess–Zumino theories as a comparison boundary
Euclidean axionic hypermultiplets through an alternate question
targets: Minkowski, de Sitter and anti-de Sitter configurations
Scalar stabilization, flat directions and metastability
Inflation, cosmological phases and supersymmetry breaking
Hidden-sector constraints and observable soft terms
regimes: Stationary vacua and evolving cosmological configurations are distinguished
Tree-level and effective-theory regimes where explicitly specified
assumptions: Numerical memberships are candidates, not an accepted scientific grouping
No-scale structure, particular Kähler geometries and absence of a stabilizer are route-specific
Ordinary and pre-Swampland work remains eligible
Source claims of stability, control or phenomenological success are not independently certified
conventions: Positive potential, positive stationary energy, positive Euclidean action and strict scalar stability are different properties
One chiral field need not mean one real scalar
Finite moduli-coordinate displacement is distinguished from canonical field distance
includes: Model-specific tests of proposed de Sitter bounds
excludes: Equivalence inferred from common overview membership
Euclidean positive-action saddles as evidence for positive vacuum energy

sources.title: Moduli stabilization in 5D gauged supergravity with universal hypermultiplet and boundary superpotentials

evidence.text: How do graviphoton gaugings and perturbative boundary superpotentials stabilize the radion and universal-hypermultiplet modulus, and which supersymmetric AdS stationary points support an uplift to a SUSY-breaking Minkowski vacuum?

sources.title: Emerging Potentials in Higher-Derivative Gauged Chiral Models Coupled to N=1 Supergravity

evidence.text: Can selected higher-derivative interactions generate scalar potentials in chiral models coupled to N=1 supergravity, including vanishing-superpotential models, while preserving algebraic auxiliary elimination? Can gauged D-terms raise the emergent negative contribution to Minkowski or de Sitter vacuum energy?

sources.title: Cosmological attractors from α-scale supergravity

evidence.text: Can α-attractor inflation and stable de Sitter regimes be constructed with one chiral superfield by deforming no-scale supergravity, and what survives in the singular flat-Kähler limit?

sources.title: From Minkowski to de Sitter in Multifield No-Scale Models

evidence.text: Which superpotentials yield Minkowski and constant dS/AdS potentials in no-scale supergravity, how do their pairings generalize geometrically to multiple fields, and how can matter and inflation be incorporated?

sources.title: Locally Supersymmetric Effective Field Theories of Inflation

evidence.text: How can four-dimensional N=1 supergravity scalar potentials be enlarged to support single-field slow-roll inflation, de Sitter vacua and scalar stabilization, and what nonrenormalizable interactions constrain these constructions as EFTs?

sources.title: From Minkowski to de Sitter vacua with various geometries

evidence.text: Can the construction of dS/AdS vacua from paired Minkowski superpotentials be extended to flat, compact, non-compact, and mixed Kähler geometries while breaking SUSY, stabilizing hidden-sector scalars, and generating observable-sector soft terms?

sources.title: Supersymmetric horizons at the edge of effective field theory

evidence.text: Can a single effective supergravity potential connect inflation, metastable de Sitter acceleration, Minkowski crossings and asymptotic supersymmetric AdS, while controlling moduli and large canonical field excursions?

sources.title: Moduli stabilization in 5D gauged supergravity with universal hypermultiplet and boundary superpotentials

evidence.text: Uses the imported N=1 off-shell superconformal formulation and off-shell dimensional reduction. At low energies, kinetic terms of Z₂-odd multiplets are dropped; their equations act as constraints extracting zero modes from even multiplets. This yields effective Kähler and superpotentials while retaining N=1 off-shell structure.

sources.title: Emerging Potentials in Higher-Derivative Gauged Chiral Models Coupled to N=1 Supergravity

evidence.text: Construct superspace actions, project to bosonic components, eliminate gravity auxiliaries, perform Weyl rescaling, and solve the remaining algebraic chiral-auxiliary equations. Substituting distinct solutions produces distinct on-shell branches.

sources.title: Cosmological attractors from α-scale supergravity

evidence.text: Evaluate the scalar potential and transverse scalar mass for monomial superpotentials, combine the two zero-potential branches to obtain a positive plateau, and introduce a function F to deform that plateau.

sources.title: From Minkowski to de Sitter in Multifield No-Scale Models

evidence.text: Restrict the scalar potential to the real-field locus and solve first-order equations for W(T): a homogeneous equation for V=0 and an inhomogeneous equation for constant V=Λ. The latter analysis introduces a monomial-plus-second-power ansatz.

sources.title: Locally Supersymmetric Effective Field Theories of Inflation

evidence.text: Superconformal tensor calculus constructs composite multiplets and D-density actions. The gauge-equivalence program introduces compensators and extra symmetries, then fixes them to recover physical Poincaré supergravity.

sources.title: From Minkowski to de Sitter vacua with various geometries

evidence.text: Along Z=Z*, requiring V=0 reduces the superpotential problem to d(log W0)/dZ=±√(3gK)−KZ. The two branches are integrated and combined; multi-field constructions use a product ansatz and separated equations with coefficients constrained by a sphere.

sources.title: Soft supersymmetry breaking with tiny cosmological constant in flux compactified N=1 Supergravity

evidence.text: What restrictions on hidden-sector Kähler and superpotentials can jointly produce gravity-mediated TeV-scale soft supersymmetry breaking, stabilized hidden fields without flat directions, and a tiny positive total vacuum energy?

sources.title: Decoupling and de Sitter Vacua in Approximate No-Scale Supergravities

evidence.text: When can small superpotential deformations lift no-scale Minkowski vacua to metastable de Sitter vacua, while keeping the number of stability tunings independent of the number of chiral fields?

sources.title: De Sitter Vacua in No-Scale Supergravity

evidence.text: How can single-field no-scale constructions of constant positive vacuum energy be extended to multiple chiral fields, while controlling imaginary-direction stability and the allowed powers in the superpotential?

sources.title: de Sitter Conjectures in $N$=1 Supergravity

evidence.text: How does a homogeneous superpotential exponent determine positive stationary energies and scalar stability in a phase-invariant one-chiral-field supergravity model?

sources.title: Continuous degeneracy of non-supersymmetric vacua

evidence.text: Does the tree-level instability-or-degeneracy result extend to global Wess–Zumino theories with arbitrarily many chiral fields and non-renormalizable holomorphic superpotentials? How does the flat direction relate to R-symmetry, and what restrictions follow for effective-theory vacuum statistics?

sources.title: F-term multi-field inflation in supergravity without stabiliser superfields

evidence.text: Can the stabiliser-free single-chiral-superfield mechanism be extended to several chiral superfields while retaining a positive, sufficiently flat F-term inflationary potential and stabilizing directions orthogonal to the protected real fields?

sources.title: Universal dS vacua in STU-models

evidence.text: Can polynomial superpotentials with generalized fluxes yield analytically controlled stable de Sitter critical points near supersymmetric or no-scale Minkowski points, and reproduce the local vacuum properties obtained using nonperturbative superpotentials?

sources.title: Single-Superfield Helical-Phase Inflation

evidence.text: Can helical-phase inflation in supergravity be realized with a single chiral superfield, using stabilization of its radial scalar instead of an additional stabilizer superfield, while obtaining positive quadratic, plateau or natural-inflation potentials?

destination.title: Instantons, effective interactions and nonperturbative geometry
destination.question: How do instantons contribute to effective interactions, vacuum dynamics, geometric structures and nonperturbative sectors in the specified theories?
destination.summary: A proposed umbrella for related questions with different systems, dimensions and observables. The strongest coupling-calculus anchors support only part of the numerical neighborhood; small-instanton spectra, classical backgrounds and reconstruction programs supply separate useful directions.

systems: Gauge theories and their instanton sectors
Type I/II, heterotic, M-theory and F-theory settings specified by individual sources
Small-instanton branes and their worldvolume theories
targets: Moduli stabilization, axion potentials and field ranges
Quantum moduli geometry and accessible regimes
Charges, symmetries and conjectural consistency constraints
Soliton moduli, emergent sectors and internal-geometry reconstruction
regimes: Source-specific dimensions, supersymmetry, flux choices and zero-mode sectors
Conditional extensions and alternatives where an instanton mechanism is obstructed
assumptions: Numerical membership is retrieval provenance, not scientific equivalence
No common flux choice, instanton type, observable or conjecture is imposed across the family
conventions: Instanton terminology retains each source's distinction between Euclidean corrections, background solutions and small-instanton sectors
Poly-instantons, multiple wrapping and multi-instanton contributions are not interchangeable labels
includes: Useful alternate homes outside the holomorphic-coupling core
Explicitly bounded negative results, comparisons and future investigations
excludes: A universal instanton correction or universal nonvanishing theorem
Automatic transfer between moduli-only and matter-dependent superpotentials
Automatic transfer between N=2 metric corrections and N=1 potentials
Equating small-instanton gauge sectors with Euclidean superpotential contributions

sources.title: Instantons and Holomorphic Couplings in Intersecting D-brane Models

evidence.text: How do non-holomorphic string thresholds and instanton correlation functions determine holomorphic Wilsonian couplings, constrain matter Kähler metrics, and generate perturbative or instanton corrections to Fayet-Iliopoulos terms?

sources.title: Lectures on instantons

evidence.text: How are Yang–Mills instantons, their zero modes and integration measures constructed, and how do they describe nonperturbative tunnelling, anomalous chiral interactions and Higgs suppression of large instantons?

sources.title: D-Brane Instantons in Type II Orientifolds

evidence.text: Which D-brane instantons generate holomorphic couplings in four-dimensional N=1 Type II compactifications, how do their zero modes determine the allowed terms, and what applications follow for moduli stabilization and particle physics?

sources.title: F-term Stabilization of Odd Axions in LARGE Volume Scenario

evidence.text: Can F-term effects from fluxed E3 instantons and fluxed poly-instantons stabilize orientifold-odd axions in LARGE volume toy models, and what decay constants, stability properties and mass hierarchies result?

sources.title: Instantons and Supersymmetry

evidence.text: How does instanton calculus describe nonperturbative effects in four-dimensional globally supersymmetric gauge theories with N=1,2,4, and how are gauge instantons related to D-branes and tests of gauge/string duality? This is a pedagogical review.

sources.title: Effects of D instantons

evidence.text: Which effective interactions arise from D-instanton fermionic zero modes in type IIB theory, what SL(2,Z) completion could organize the R⁴ coupling, and what do instanton disk subprocesses imply about high-energy fixed-angle scattering?

sources.title: M theory, Joyce orbifolds and superYang-Mills

evidence.text: Can singular Joyce orbifolds geometrically engineer four-dimensional N=1 pure Yang–Mills theories, and can fractional membrane instantons account for their superpotential and chiral anomaly?

sources.title: Small instantons and weak scale string theory

evidence.text: Can small-instanton gauge sectors support four-dimensional gauge interactions while the heterotic string scale is arbitrarily low, in weakly and strongly coupled descriptions? What possible roles do these sectors have in supersymmetry breaking?

sources.title: Instantons and Holomorphic Couplings in Intersecting D-brane Models

evidence.text: The E2 prescription integrates charged fermionic zero modes against disc amplitudes, with precisely two instanton zero modes per disc, and includes massive-state annulus/Möbius determinants. The displayed superpotential treatment excludes matter-field insertions on loop diagrams.

sources.title: Lectures on instantons

evidence.text: Completes the Yang–Mills action into a duality square plus a topological term. Constructs solutions using a sigma-matrix ansatz proportional to a derivative of ln φ, with the Bianchi identity connecting selfduality to the field equations.

sources.title: D-Brane Instantons in Type II Orientifolds

evidence.text: For the quiver examples, arrows incident on an instanton node become charged Grassmann modes, and hypothetical spacetime-brane superpotential terms determine their interactions. In selected geometries, brane-to-flux transitions provide an alternative computation through flux superpotentials and periods, including multicover contributions.

sources.title: F-term Stabilization of Odd Axions in LARGE Volume Scenario

evidence.text: Sum integer instanton flux sectors to obtain a holomorphic Jacobi-theta prefactor. With the chosen stabilized axio-dilaton, this supplies the odd-axion dependence used in the effective superpotential.

sources.title: Instantons and Supersymmetry

evidence.text: Semiclassical saddle-point expansion reduces correlators to collective-coordinate integrals. Grassmann integration requires saturation of fermion zero modes. The index theorem gives nL−nR=2ℓ[R]K; for an adjoint Weyl fermion in a positive-charge instanton background, nL=2NcK. The review describes cancellation of regularized nonzero-mode determinants in supersymmetric backgrounds.

sources.title: Effects of D instantons

evidence.text: Use T-duality in nine Euclidean dimensions to map multiply wrapped world-lines of charge-n D-particles to D-instantons of charge mn. Poisson resummation and a K₁ Bessel-function expansion analyze the proposed modular coefficient.

sources.title: More about F-term uplifting

evidence.text: This family tests whether an instanton-dependent supersymmetry-breaking tadpole can coexist with stabilization of the same modulus controlling the instanton.

sources.title: Minimal Surfaces and Weak Gravity

evidence.text: Can the instanton Weak Gravity Conjecture constrain volumes of non-calibrated minimal four-cycles, forcing substantial recombination of holomorphic and antiholomorphic representatives?

sources.title: On TCS G$_{2}$ manifolds and 4D emergent strings

evidence.text: Can omitted flux and instanton superpotentials dynamically obstruct the degeneration, independently of the proposed metric correction?

sources.title: Backreacting D-brane instantons on branes at singularities

evidence.text: How does D-brane instanton backreaction reproduce charged matter insertions in the four-dimensional effective action when the instanton intersects gauge D-branes?

sources.title: Supersymmetric Protection and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can all superpotential corrections be excluded in heterotic and other N = 1 string compactifications when stringy instanton sectors are incompletely understood?

sources.title: The EFT stringy viewpoint on large distances

evidence.text: Can a global perturbative domain be defined when D2 instantons change stability? The domain and its instanton inequalities must be mutually compatible.

sources.title: Warped generalized geometry compactifications, effective theories and non-perturbative effects

evidence.text: How can warped type II N=1 compactifications with general SU(3)×SU(3) structure be encoded in four-dimensional supergravity data, and how do instantons or gaugino condensation alter their ten-dimensional supersymmetry conditions and mobile-D3 potentials?

sources.title: Recent developments in heterotic compactifications

evidence.text: How can heterotic worldsheet instantons correct charged superpotential couplings when the gauge bundle differs from the tangent bundle?

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture as a Razor Criterium for Exotic D-brane instantons

evidence.text: Can an extension of the Weak Gravity Conjecture to exotic D-brane instantons select admissible instanton-generated superpotentials and constrain their particle-physics consequences?

sources.title: The EFT stringy viewpoint on large distances

evidence.text: How do calibrated G2 branes realize four-dimensional axionic strings and instantons? Associative periods provide the saxions for their actions and tensions.

sources.title: D-instanton induced superpotential

evidence.text: How can string field theory fix the overall normalization of D-instanton contributions to the moduli superpotential in fluxless Calabi–Yau orientifolds, and do multiple instantons of the specified type contribute?

sources.title: Monopole breaking of Chern-Weil symmetries

evidence.text: How do dynamical magnetic monopoles explicitly break instantonic Chern-Weil symmetries, when can dyon modes restore improved currents, and when does Higgsing preserve precisely the UV instanton symmetry in the IR?

sources.title: Natural inflation and moduli stabilization in heterotic orbifolds

evidence.text: Can heterotic orbifolds generate sufficient KNP axion alignment while stabilizing the dilaton and relevant geometric moduli during inflation? Why should world-sheet instantons and gaugino condensates, despite their different origins, have nearly aligned moduli dependence?

sources.title: Non-perturbative superpotentials in F-theory and string duality

evidence.text: Can string duality compute flux-dependent D3-instanton superpotentials, including determinants and multiwrappings, in an explicit KKLT-type setting, and motivate a generalized GVW superpotential for type II compactifications?

sources.title: Vector bundle moduli superpotentials in heterotic superstrings and M theory

evidence.text: How can the vector-bundle-moduli dependence and vanishing divisor of a once-wrapped heterotic instanton's Pfaffian, and hence its superpotential contribution, be computed explicitly using algebraic geometry?

sources.title: Superpotentials for vector bundle moduli

evidence.text: How can the zeros and explicit vector-bundle-moduli dependence of a heterotic worldsheet-instanton Pfaffian, and hence its superpotential contribution, be computed? The paper develops a method and calculates one SU(3) example.

sources.title: D-instanton superpotential in string theory

evidence.text: Does the type IIB superpotential receive bare D(−1)-instanton corrections when all D7 stacks carry SO(8), and can F-theory periods determine this at finite string coupling?

sources.title: Notes on instantons in topological field theory and beyond

evidence.text: How can instanton theories be studied beyond their BPS sector in a limit that retains instantons but removes anti-instantons, and can this solvable limit support perturbation theory for general observables without linearizing the space of fields?

sources.title: Heterotic Instantons for Monad and Extension Bundles

evidence.text: How can heterotic world-sheet instanton superpotentials be computed for monad and extension bundles, and when can contributions in one curve class avoid cancellation despite the Beasley–Witten vanishing theorem?

sources.title: Kaleidoscopes, Waves and the Prepotential

evidence.text: Which Coxeter groups arise from isomorphic flops, and how do their symmetries constrain and resum the invariant instanton functions entering the Type IIA prepotential?

sources.title: Supersymmetric Protection and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can an explicit smooth dual geometry exhibit a stringy heterotic NS5 instanton contribution without relying on additional zero-mode lifting? The selected examples vary the discrete twist t over a P2 base.

sources.title: On the 3-form formulation of axion potentials from D-brane instantons

evidence.text: What four-dimensional 3-form describes axion potentials generated by non-gauge D-brane instantons, when neither a gauge Chern-Simons composite nor a suitable harmonic form is apparent in the original Calabi-Yau compactification?

sources.title: Superpotentials from singular divisors

evidence.text: When can Euclidean D3-branes wrapping singular effective divisors generate nonperturbative superpotential terms, and how should their fermion zero modes be counted?

sources.title: Gauge and gravitational instantons: From 3-forms and fermions to Weak Gravity and flat axion potentials

evidence.text: Can fermion exchange between distinct instantons add a distance-dependent force between externally imposed θ-domain walls? The calculation uses one light Dirac flavor, two planar walls, a small source, and the first two orders in the instanton-induced interaction.

sources.title: Instanton induced Yukawa couplings from distant E3 and E(-1) instantons

evidence.text: When can spatially separated E3 and fractional E(-1) instantons generate D3-brane Yukawa couplings, and what are their separation dependence, flavour structure and implications for superpotential desequestering?

sources.title: Instabilities in heterotic M theory induced by open membrane instantons

evidence.text: What leading scalar potential do open membrane instantons generate in strongly coupled heterotic compactifications, and when does it attract M5-branes toward boundaries or drive decompactification?

sources.title: Power Towers of String Instantons for N=1 Vacua

evidence.text: Can string instantons correct other instantons' actions, producing iterated power towers in N=1 holomorphic couplings, and can a refined D-brane instanton calculus distinguish these effects from multiply wrapped single instantons in a proposed heterotic–Type I dual pair?

sources.title: Gauging the Standard Model 1-form symmetry via gravitational instantons

evidence.text: Can Eguchi–Hanson gravitational instantons support consistent Standard Model electric Z6 1-form fluxes, provide a semiclassical realization of gauging this symmetry, and induce baryon- and lepton-number violation?

sources.title: 8d supergravity, reconstruction of internal geometry and the Swampland

evidence.text: Gauge instantons of different eight-dimensional factors couple to the same bulk four-form. Their charges can therefore be compared using Q=ℓn, where ℓ is also the current-algebra level measured by the electric 1-brane.

sources.title: Towards a Swampland Global Symmetry Conjecture using weak gravity

evidence.text: How can ordinary four-dimensional gauge instantons realize charged endpoint dressing? The model couples chiral U(1)-charged SU(N) fermions to a gauged axion whose topological coupling cancels their mixed gauge variation.

sources.title: A Note on Poly-Instanton Effects in Type IIB Orientifolds on Calabi-Yau Threefolds

evidence.text: What sufficient E3-instanton zero-mode conditions generate poly-instanton corrections in compact Type IIB O7/O3 orientifolds, and can suitable divisors coexist with shrinkable del Pezzo surfaces relevant to LARGE volume constructions?

sources.title: Supersymmetric Protection and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can gauge and worldsheet effects alone supply a universal obstruction to vanishing heterotic superpotentials? The paper tests this through standard embeddings and Bianchi-saturating non-standard candidates.

sources.title: On the M-theory description of supersymmetric gluodynamics

evidence.text: How does compactifying one spatial direction of N=1 SU(N) supersymmetric Yang–Mills change its string dual, and can constituent instantons generate its nonperturbative superpotential directly in that description?

sources.title: Systematics of Axion Inflation in Calabi-Yau Hypersurfaces

evidence.text: Can instanton-charge alignment produce a super-Planckian range for C4 axions without monodromy in controlled type IIB compactifications on toric Calabi–Yau hypersurfaces?

sources.title: Instantons and infinite distances

evidence.text: Are instanton-driven changes of distance and curvature shared by other infinite-distance classes or by N=1 orientifold compactifications with nonperturbative effects?

sources.title: Nonperturbative superpotentials in string theory

evidence.text: Which wrapped-brane instantons generate nonperturbative superpotentials in M-theory on Calabi–Yau fourfolds, and what can their divisor geometry establish about corresponding four-dimensional F-theory and heterotic compactifications?

sources.title: The Convex Hull Swampland Distance Conjecture and Bounds on Non-geodesics

evidence.text: Which potential structures force SDC-compatible critical valleys, and do instanton effects or discrete symmetries preserve that mechanism?

sources.title: The Landscape, the Swampland and the Era of Precision Cosmology

evidence.text: Can selected four-dimensional string/M-theory quintessence constructions explain late-time acceleration while satisfying expansion-history data, and do the cited no-go arguments exclude the ingredients used in de Sitter stabilization?

sources.title: The Landscape, the Swampland and the Era of Precision Cosmology

evidence.text: Do earlier string quintessence proposals support a universal positive-gradient conjecture, or rely on stabilization and inflationary potentials with stationary points?

sources.title: Isocurvature Perturbations of Dark Energy and Dark Matter from the Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Can an early attractor remove primordial quintessence memory while preserving late accelerated expansion?

sources.title: Quintessence and the Swampland: The Numerically Controlled Regime of Moduli Space

evidence.text: Which microscopic realization explains late-time acceleration: a cosmological constant, scalar quintessence, or pseudoscalar quintessence? The authors further ask whether perturbative compactifications suffice or whether understanding the vacuum structure needs nonperturbative string input.

sources.title: Reconstruction of the Quintessence Dark Energy Potential from a Gaussian Process

evidence.text: Can expansion-rate data and Gaussian-process reconstructions of H(z) and its derivative reconstruct a quintessence potential without choosing its functional form, and how do kernel and H0 choices affect potential selection and interpretations of the H0 tension?

sources.title: Exponential quintessence: curved, steep and stringy?

evidence.text: Can single-field exponential quintessence reproduce a radiation-dominated past and acceleration today, especially for λ ≥ √2, and can negative spatial curvature improve its prospects for a string realization?

sources.title: Quintessence, cosmic coincidence, and the cosmological constant

evidence.text: Can scalar-field tracker evolution reduce the initial-condition tuning behind present-day matter–quintessence coincidence, produce late acceleration, and predict a relation between present matter density and quintessence equation of state?

sources.title: Cosmological tracking solutions

evidence.text: Which scalar potentials admit tracker solutions insensitive to initial conditions, what relation do they impose between present quintessence density and equation of state, and can they make late quintessence domination more plausible?

sources.title: Quintessence arising from exponential potentials

evidence.text: Can sums of exponential scalar potentials combine early radiation/matter scaling with late quintessence domination, yielding a sufficiently negative present equation of state over a wide range of initial conditions?

sources.title: String theory and quintessence

evidence.text: Can an eternally accelerating universe admit operationally meaningful observables analogous to an S-matrix or S-vector? Does replacing de Sitter expansion with quintessence avoid the obstruction, and can acceleration persist while a scalar approaches a stable zero-energy supersymmetric vacuum?

sources.title: The Acceleration of the universe, a challenge for string theory

evidence.text: Does quintessence explaining present acceleration generically continue accelerating forever, producing event horizons and the same difficulties for string-theory observables as an asymptotic de Sitter universe?

sources.title: The Landscape, the Swampland and the Era of Precision Cosmology

evidence.text: Fit observations directly in the physical model's parameter space with Bayesian MCMC, and independently profile the likelihood for the reported single-exponential check. This retains model information omitted by the envelope comparison.

sources.title: Isocurvature Perturbations of Dark Energy and Dark Matter from the Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Compare DM-induced quantum corrections with the tree-level quintessence potential and apply the imported parametric inequality. The paper does not calculate a model-specific effective potential, its counterterms, or exact prefactors.

sources.title: Quintessence and the Swampland: The Numerically Controlled Regime of Moduli Space

evidence.text: Transfer an axion diffusion assessment to a compatible saxion hilltop by replacing the local curvature parameter with |η0|. Keep the same stochastic assumptions and restrict any numerical fit to its original translated domain.

sources.title: Reconstruction of the Quintessence Dark Energy Potential from a Gaussian Process

evidence.text: Use GaPP to reconstruct H(z) and H′(z) with squared-exponential and Matérn ν=9/2 covariance kernels. The GP is a distribution over functions conditioned on observations; correlation length and fluctuation amplitude are kernel hyperparameters.

sources.title: Exponential quintessence: curved, steep and stringy?

evidence.text: Numerical trajectories are selected by present density parameters and a past radiation or matter epoch. For observational parametrization, the authors compute both a local CPL tangent and least-squares fits of wϕ(a) over 0.2 ≤ a/a0 ≤ 1, corresponding to redshifts 0–4.

sources.title: Quintessence, cosmic coincidence, and the cosmological constant

evidence.text: The authors compute illustrative background histories, linear matter power spectra, and CMB temperature-anisotropy spectra using modified CMBFAST routines. The spectra are compared with then-available APM, COBE, Big Plate, and CAT observations.

sources.title: Generalised DBI-Quintessence

evidence.text: How does adding multiplicative and additive potentials to DBI quintessence, motivated by multiple or partially wrapped branes, change its equation of state, fixed points and phase-space dynamics?

sources.title: Hybrid quintessence with an end or quintessence from branes and large dimensions

evidence.text: Can a second scalar terminate tracker quintessence, avoiding an eternally accelerating future, and can the required potential and tiny energy density arise from brane interactions?

sources.title: Gravitational Wave Signatures from Warm Dark Energy

evidence.text: Can gauge friction reconcile a steep quintessence potential with an equation of state close to minus one? The motivation combines conjectural slope restrictions with separately imported observational limits.

sources.title: Cosmic birefringence from monodromic axion dark energy

evidence.text: Do the decay-constant and equation-of-state relations survive replacing a linear monodromy potential with a broader monomial potential?

sources.title: Quintessence, flat potential and string / M theory axion

evidence.text: Can quintessence retain an extremely flat potential despite matter and quantum-gravity effects, and can heterotic M-theory or Type I axions realize it with viable cosmological initial conditions?

sources.title: Constraints on quintessence scalar field models using cosmological observations

evidence.text: Can selected quintessence potentials explain late cosmic acceleration, have their shape parameters constrained by cosmological observations, relieve the H0 tension, and compete statistically with ΛCDM?

sources.title: Comments on the Transplanckian Censorship Conjecture

evidence.text: What rolling scalar backgrounds can provide accelerated expansion while their potential tends toward zero? The paper uses a fixed exponential potential as an instructive model for the large-field portion of a possible quintessence landscape.

sources.title: Gravitational Wave Signatures from Warm Dark Energy

evidence.text: Can a classical isotropic non-Abelian field slow late-time quintessence on a steep potential? The immediate friction mechanism operates in the homogeneous equations.

sources.title: Hilltop Quintessence

evidence.text: What common evolution w(a) describes quintessence rolling near a potential maximum when w remains near −1, but the potential curvature need not satisfy the slow-roll restriction?

sources.title: Forays into the dark side of the swamp

evidence.text: How much can canonical exponential quintessence move over cosmological time, and can that motion generate the parameter changes required by the particle-physics examples?

sources.title: Warm dark energy

evidence.text: Can gauge-field production reconcile order-one quintessence potential slopes with late-time acceleration constraints? Can the Anber–Sorbo steady solution emerge dynamically from an earlier matter- or radiation-dominated era?

sources.title: Dynamical Analysis of Scalar Field Cosmologies with Spatial Curvature

evidence.text: Does spatial curvature qualitatively change exponential-potential quintessence dynamics, particularly by introducing an attractor with equation of state different from −1?

sources.title: Reconstructing Quintessence

evidence.text: Canonical quintessence replaces a constant dark-energy density with a minimally coupled scalar whose kinetic and potential energies determine cosmic expansion. A potential alone does not determine the history; scalar boundary conditions are also needed.

sources.title: The multi-feature universe: Large parameter space cosmology and the swampland

evidence.text: Can an interacting exponential quintessence trajectory satisfy the reconstructed late-time expansion constraints while having a slope compatible with the conjectural threshold c?

sources.title: Dynamical System Analysis of Quintessence Models with Exponential Potential - Revisited

evidence.text: Can exponential-potential quintessence with matter and radiation reproduce the required sequence of cosmological eras and present acceleration, and how does selecting a continuous trajectory through observed density parameters constrain the potential slope α?

sources.title: S-dual quintessence, the Swampland, and the DESI DR2 results

evidence.text: Why should a late-time quintessence field begin near an unstable maximum instead of at a generic point on its potential?
